subject: standoff height
evidence_needed: received board and installed THT lead-trim envelope; select one height and reject the others

subject: top fastener
evidence_needed: exact screw, washer if used, head envelope, material, thread engagement, torque and locking method

subject: panel fastener
evidence_needed: exact screw/washer/nut or stud system, panel-side access, thread engagement, torque and locking method

subject: received panel
evidence_needed: 18P2721 identity, thickness, flatness, coating, enclosure fit, inserts/keepouts and rear access survey

subject: panel drilling
evidence_needed: released hole diameter/tolerance, coordinate datum, drill/deburr/coating-repair method and first-article measurement

subject: underside clearance
evidence_needed: received THT protrusion and solder-fillet measurements, lead-trim limit, contamination clearance and no-contact inspection

subject: electrical isolation/bonding
evidence_needed: qualified disposition for plastic hardware, PCB domains, steel panel bond and fault/EMC behavior

subject: mechanical proof
evidence_needed: board mass/COM, connector insertion and conductor-torque loads, static pull, vibration and service-cycle acceptance

subject: assembly process
evidence_needed: assembler acceptance of lands, stencil, mask, paste, reflow/manual-THT, cleaning, AOI and rework limits

subject: ISO1 insulation system
evidence_needed: working voltage, OVC, pollution degree, material group, coating, altitude, environment, standard/jurisdiction and qualified calculation

subject: physical first article
evidence_needed: received-board dimensions, holes, warp, isolation gap, polarity, solder, contamination and mounting inspection

subject: authorization
evidence_needed: independent PCB/assembly review plus controlled fabrication and later energization work authorization
